items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: autographed by good friends... including... Pete Mellom

ctx.x: Now, we have here a little write up that says this script was composed and written June the 3rd, 1955. Let's see, and copyrighted it looks like there too. By Tom Brown, an autographed by good friends. 38 names more on the back, including Tom Brown first, and then Sherwood Manjapan, Edmond Sushan, M.D., Pete Mellom, Mara Menville, Frank Bonin, singer Johnny Wiggs, Bill Lambert, Alfred Lobre, Vincent Varisco. Somebody Brown whose name I can't read. Yes.
Is that FN? Looks like the FN. Oh, uh, Varisco, Vincent. Oh, Vincent Varisco. He played the tom.
